lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly `nix flake update`. CI builds x86_64 and evaluates aarch64; a green check auto-merges and the Publisher does the real aarch64 build before anything ships (decision Q15).

customManagers.description: Service flake inputs pinned by tag (github:grmhay/<repo>/vX.Y.Z). The nix manager only tracks their locked rev as git-refs, never the tag, so this is what proposes a tag bump. Its PRs bump flake.nix only, not flake.lock: before merging one, run `nix flake update <input>` on the PR's branch and push the new flake.lock to the PR, or master's lock still pins the old tag's rev.

packageRules.description: Lockfile maintenance (nixpkgs) auto-merges on green CI
Service flake inputs (github:grmhay/*) always get a human
